Native local ERC reference context

Source: ../attribute-edit/cpNode-IOX.kicad_sch and its recorded native provenance.
local.kicad_sym contains that fixture's two exact cached definitions, with only
outer names adapted from SPCoast:R / power:+5V to standalone R / +5V.
Nested short body names, pins, graphics, defaults, and opaque payloads are unchanged.
The wrapper declares native symbol-library format 20251024.

sym-lib-table registers SPCoast and power against ${KIPRJMOD}/local.kicad_sym.
The native ERC gate intentionally does NOT copy this library into its staged
project: URI projection must retain the ORIGINAL fixture-copy location.
Otherwise KiCad emits false missing-symbol-library findings.

No footprint library is registered in this controlled context. Its native
footprint-link findings remain legitimate and are not filtered or downgraded.
The report can contain both these context findings and the fixture's electrical
findings. The gate does not hard-code a universal total finding count.

Behavior anchors: kproj/tests/contract/test_kicad_cli_erc.py and
kproj/tests/unit/services/test_design_analyzer.py. Their useful per-sheet,
item, execution, and cleanup scenarios are retained without the donor's refill
flag bug, severity policy, tolerant empty-report fallback, or flattened findings.
